LanguageData.OperatorGreysia.label: Operator Greysia
LanguageData.OperatorGreysia.description: Greysia is the switchboard operator, the clerk and the chief secretary of a Colonial Army office, and to her your colony looks like some sort of field unit, which makes it a good place to send things. She routes every contract, supply run and security alert onto your frequency. The Colonization Forces will always be on the line, and their enemies with them.
